question: The Himalayas have been divided on the basis of regions from west to east. The correct order of regions from west to east is:

options.text: Punjab Himalayas, Nepal Himalayas, Kumaon Himalayas and Assam Himalayas
Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalayas, Nepal Himalayas and Assam Himalayas
Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalayas, Assam Himalayas and Nepal Himalayas
Punjab Himalayas, Nepal Himalayas, Assam Himalayas and Kumaon Himalayas

solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalayas, Nepal Himalayas and Assam Himalayas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Himalayas **have been divided on the basis of regions from **west to east**. The correct order of regions from west to east is **Punjab Himalayas, Kumaon Himalayas, Nepal Himalayas and Assam Himalayas.**
 
• **The Himalayas,** spanning vast distances from west to east, are divided into distinct regions, each characterized by unique **geographical and geological features.**
 
• Beginning in the **west, the Punjab Himalayas** mark the initial segment of this majestic mountain range.
 
• Stretching from the** Indus River to the Sutlej River**, this region encompasses parts of present-day Pakistan and northern India.
 
• Here, the towering peaks give way to rolling foothills and fertile plains, defining the landscape of the region.
 
• Moving eastward,** the Kumaon Himalayas** form the central portion of the range, encompassing the state of Uttarakhand and western Nepal.
 
• This region is renowned for its breathtaking vistas, including snow-capped peaks, deep valleys, and dense forests.
 
• Prominent peaks such as **Nanda Devi and Trisul **dominate the skyline, attracting adventurers and nature enthusiasts alike.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Himalayas are divided into six regions from **east to west: Purvanchal, Arunachal, Central & Sikkim, Kumaun, Himachal, and Kashmir. **
